s5-remove-outermost-paranthesis.trick: Track nesting depth; omit an opening parenthesis at depth zero and a closing parenthesis that returns to zero.

s5-reverse-words-in-a-given-string-palin.trick: Extract words, then emit them in reverse order. For a palindrome check, compare characters from both ends.

s5-largest-odd-number-in-a-string.trick: A decimal number is odd exactly when its final digit is odd; keep the longest prefix ending in an odd digit.

s5-longest-common-prefix.trick: Test each character of the first string against the same position in every other string; stop at the first mismatch.

s5-isomorphic-string.trick: Keep mappings in both directions so two different source characters cannot map to the same target character.

s5-check-whether-one-string-is-a-rotatio.trick: A rotation of s must occur inside s+s; KMP checks this in linear time.

s5-check-if-two-strings-are-anagram-of-e.trick: Matching strings have identical frequency counts for every character.

s5-sort-characters-by-frequency.trick: Count each byte, sort the distinct bytes by decreasing frequency, and emit each as many times as it appeared.

s5-maximum-nesting-depth-of-paranthesis.trick: Increment depth at each opening parenthesis, decrement at each closing one, and record the maximum.

s5-roman-number-to-integer-and-vice-vers.trick: For Roman-to-integer, subtract a symbol smaller than its successor. For integer-to-Roman, greedily take the largest symbol or subtractive pair.
s5-roman-number-to-integer-and-vice-vers.time: O(length) for parsing; O(1) for conventional 1..3999 formatting

s5-implement-atoi.trick: Skip leading spaces, read one optional sign, then accumulate digits while clamping to 32-bit limits before multiplication.

s5-longest-palindromic-substring-do-it-w.trick: Expand around every character and every gap; keep the longest matching span.

s5-sum-of-beauty-of-all-substring.trick: Fix each start, extend the end, maintain letter counts, and add max positive frequency minus min positive frequency.

s5-reverse-every-word-in-a-string.trick: Find each word boundary, then reverse only that word's characters; leave spaces in place.

s5-count-number-of-substrings.trick: Count substrings with exactly k distinct characters as atMost(k) minus atMost(k-1), using a sliding window.
